data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Add a "Draft PR Creation" section to sprint/SKILL.md Phase A (after Mode Detection, gated by SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr). Also create a structural test asserting the section exists and update .test-index.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: post-Phase-A, gh pr list returns one draft PR with session branch as head and main as base
- DD3: Phase A blocks Phase E dispatch until PR creation completes

## SKILL.md Addition

After the Mode Detection section (which emits MODE: ci-pr or MODE: local banners) and before the Context Efficiency Rules section, add:

```markdown
### Draft PR Creation (ci-pr mode only)

When `SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr`, open a long-lived draft PR from the session branch to main before Phase E dispatch. The draft PR serves as the substrate for GitHubPRDefenseStore (S8/S10).

```bash
if [[ "${SPRINT_MODE:-}" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
    DRAFT_PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
        --draft \
        --base main \
        --head "$SESSION_BRANCH" \
        --title "Sprint: ${EPIC_TITLE:-epic} (${primary_ticket_id})" \
        --body "Long-lived sprint draft PR. Epic: ${primary_ticket_id}. Session branch: ${SESSION_BRANCH}." \
        2>&1) || DRAFT_PR_URL=""
    if [[ -z "$DRAFT_PR_URL" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Phase A draft PR creation failed — halting before Phase E dispatch" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Draft PR created: $DRAFT_PR_URL"
fi
```

**Phase E gate**: Phase E sub-agent dispatch must not begin until this block completes (it runs synchronously before Phase E).
```

## Structural Test

Create tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-phase-a-draft-pr.sh:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/assert.sh"

_skill="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md"
_skill_content=$(cat "$_skill")

assert_contains "SKILL.md: Draft PR Creation section present" \
    "### Draft PR Creation" "$_skill_content"
assert_contains "SKILL.md: gh pr create --draft present" \
    "gh pr create" "$_skill_content"
assert_contains "SKILL.md: draft flag present" \
    "--draft" "$_skill_content"
assert_contains "SKILL.md: DRAFT_PR_URL guard present" \
    "DRAFT_PR_URL" "$_skill_content"
assert_contains "SKILL.md: ci-pr mode gate present" \
    'SPRINT_MODE:-}" == "ci-pr"' "$_skill_content"

print_summary
```

Make executable. Run to confirm PASS.

## .test-index Update

Add to the sprint/SKILL.md row:
`,tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-phase-a-draft-pr.sh [test_sprint_phase_a_draft_pr_section]`

## File Impact

### Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- .test-index

### Files to Create
- tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-phase-a-draft-pr.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] sprint/SKILL.md has "### Draft PR Creation" section after Mode Detection
- [ ] Section contains gh pr create --draft, DRAFT_PR_URL capture, and Phase E gate comment
- [ ] Section is gated by SPRINT_MODE=ci-pr check
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-phase-a-draft-pr.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Structural test passes (exit 0, PASSED: 5 FAILED: 0)
- [ ] .test-index updated with [test_sprint_phase_a_draft_pr_section] for sprint/SKILL.md row
- [ ] No cross-source-key RED marker conflicts in .test-index
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on test file

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
